house_reference.why: Supplied by Valentin on 29 Oct 2026 as the standard to hit.
pattern: Frame 0 is already the person mid-gesture — no logo, no title card, no intro.
One continuous take; energy comes from the captions and the people, not from cutting.
Captions phrase-sized, all caps, heavy condensed, white with hard dark outline, centred, ~62% down the frame.
One keyword per clip in an accent colour.
Two or three small graphic inserts as punctuation (flags in, flash on the closing handshake).
No standing CTA bar and no parked logo anywhere in the clip.
Lapel mic — the voice sits 18 dB above everything under 120 Hz.
